change: Isolated within-group pooled residual variance in eyeBias. Original factorial shrinkage, BiasZ=2 and weight/count semantics retained. Baseline is original production because preceding weight experiment did not improve pilot accuracy.
primary: Mean participant paired gain-corrected population-target MSE variant minus baseline.
retain_rule: All 10 pairs complete, original replay matches committed record MSE to 1e-7, fixed controls and truth agree within each pair, unchanged search options, native/export replay pass, variant mean primary MSE strictly lower and mean raw MSE not higher. Otherwise restore original. No iterative parameter search.
scope: Exploratory development on previously examined participants; no independent confirmation or general superiority claim.
